products.name: Windows 365 Cloud PC Deployment & Management — Commercial
products.short_description: Deploy and manage Windows 365 Cloud PCs at scale — provisioning policies, images, networking, and user assignment — secured and managed from Microsoft Intune like your physical fleet. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Give users a full Windows desktop in the cloud — provisioned, secured, and managed from Intune

Contractors, BYOD staff, and offshore teams need a corporate Windows desktop, but shipping and managing a physical laptop for each one is slow and expensive. Windows 365 Cloud PCs give every user a dedicated, always-on Windows desktop streamed from the cloud — provisioned in minutes, joined to your tenant, secured by the same Intune policies as your physical fleet, and reachable from any device. This solution makes that a repeatable, governed deployment instead of a pile of one-off Cloud PCs.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Windows 365 Enterprise works, the provisioning-policy model, Azure Network Connection (ANC) vs. Microsoft-hosted network, custom vs. gallery images, and how Cloud PCs are managed exactly like physical devices in Intune.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Windows 365 Enterprise licensing, Intune, Entra ID, networking/ANC or Microsoft-hosted, an optional custom image, user group design, Conditional Access) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: licensing and groups, network connection, image, the provisioning policy, user assignment, applying Intune configuration/compliance/app policies to Cloud PCs, securing access, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — tenant-readiness discovery, Cloud PC provisioning/health validation, a Cloud PC fleet and license-utilization report, safe remediation (reprovision/resize helpers), and a provisioning-target group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every eligible user with a dedicated, always-on Windows Cloud PC — provisioned by policy, secured and managed in Intune alongside physical devices, reachable from anywhere — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • W365-Discovery.ps1 — Windows 365 tenant readiness for Cloud PC deployment
    • W365-Remediation.ps1 — safe Cloud PC remediation (reprovision / restart / resize)
    • W365-Report.ps1 — Cloud PC fleet inventory and Windows 365 license utilization
    • W365-Set-ProvisioningTargeting.ps1 — create/populate the Cloud PC targeting groups
    • W365-Validation.ps1 — confirm Cloud PCs are provisioned and healthy

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.

Government / GCC High tenant? A dedicated Government (GCC High) edition of this solution is available — authored for the US sovereign cloud (correct *.us portals, US Gov Graph endpoints, and Commercial-vs-GCC-High feature parity gaps called out).
